sections.text:
[Effects]
Physical and magic Ability Power increases by XXL - 5XL based on the wind elemental attack value.
Target: yourself. Recovers 10 Cost.
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 6XL+ when performing a critical hit.
Ability Power scales with the number of Wind elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 7XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate against Water enemies increases to L+.
Activation rate scales with the number of Wind elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XL+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
